title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_en:
Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
Children's Edition
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《三顾茅庐》的幼儿版封面，展示了四位卡通人物形象，标题醒目，风格活泼，适合儿童阅读。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh:
三国时期，有一个非常聪明的人，
他既懂得带兵打仗，又知道怎样治理
国家。这个人叫诸葛亮。
page_text_en:
During the Three Kingdoms period, there was a very smart person.
He knew how to lead troops in battle and also how to govern a country.
This person was named Zhuge Liang.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了三国时期的人物诸葛亮，描述他聪明、懂军事和治国，并配以他站在城楼、士兵在下作战的插图。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh:
刘备想：要是诸葛亮来做我的军师多好呀！
于是，他带着关羽和张飞一起去找诸葛亮。
page_text_en:
Liu Bei thought: It would be wonderful if Zhuge Liang became my military advisor!
So, he took Guan Yu and Zhang Fei with him to find Zhuge Liang.
summary_zh: 刘备希望诸葛亮成为自己的军师，于是带着关羽和张飞一同前往寻找诸葛亮。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 诸葛亮的书童告诉他们：“主人出去游玩了，可能十多天都不回来。”
page_text_en: Zhuge Liang's servant told them: "The master has gone out to play and may not return for more than ten days."
summary_zh: 刘备、关羽和张飞来到诸葛亮家中，书童告知主人外出游玩，可能十多天不归，三人显得失望和无奈。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 刘备说：“那我们在这儿等他吧！”关羽和张飞不耐烦地说：“谁知道他什么时候回来，我们难道什么都不干，就一直等下去吗？”刘备听完只好回去了。
page_text_en: Liu Bei said, "Then let's wait for him here!" Guan Yu and Zhang Fei impatiently replied, "Who knows when he'll come back? Are we supposed to do nothing and just wait forever?" Liu Bei, after hearing this, could only go back.
summary_zh: 刘备提议等待诸葛亮，但关羽和张飞认为等待无意义，最终刘备无奈决定返回。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 冬天到了，大雪纷飞，刘备又要去找诸葛亮。天太冷了，张飞不愿意去。刘备说：“我们请别人帮忙，一定要诚心诚意啊！”
page_text_en: Winter has come, and snow is falling heavily. Liu Bei wants to go find Zhuge Liang again. It's too cold, and Zhang Fei doesn't want to go. Liu Bei says, "When we ask someone for help, we must be sincere and heartfelt!"
summary_zh: 冬天大雪纷飞，刘备执意要再次前往拜访诸葛亮，张飞因天气寒冷不愿同行，刘备强调请人帮忙必须诚心诚意。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 到了诸葛亮的家，刘备看见一个年轻人在读书，他“咚咚咚”地走上前去，兴奋地说：“卧龙先生，我可找到你了！”“哎呀，你弄错了，我是他的弟弟！”原来，诸葛亮又出去游玩了。
page_text_en: They arrived at Zhuge Liang's house. Liu Bei saw a young man reading and hurried forward, excitedly saying, "Master Wolong, I've finally found you!" "Oh, you've got it wrong! I'm his younger brother!" It turned out Zhuge Liang had gone out to play again.
summary_zh: 刘备等人来到诸葛亮家中，误将他的弟弟当作诸葛亮，得知诸葛亮外出游玩后感到失望。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 春天来了，刘备决定第三次去找诸葛亮。张飞“唰”地拽出一根绳子来，说：“大哥不用去了，我用这绳子把他绑回来！”
page_text_en: Spring has come, and Liu Bei decides to go find Zhuge Liang for the third time. Zhang Fei quickly pulls out a rope and says, "Brother, you don't need to go. I'll tie him up and bring him back with this rope!"
summary_zh: 春天到来，刘备决定第三次拜访诸葛亮，张飞则拿出绳子，扬言要将诸葛亮绑回来，表现出他的急躁和鲁莽。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 刘备很生气，说：“对卧龙先生要有礼貌，不然的话别跟我去了！”，
page_text_en: Liu Bei was very angry and said, "Be polite to Mr. Wulong, or don't come with me!"
summary_zh: 刘备因张飞对诸葛亮不敬而生气，严厉警告他必须有礼貌，否则就不要同行。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh:
刘备第三次来到诸葛亮的家，
诸葛亮这次没有外出，可他正在
睡午觉。刘备叫关羽和张飞在大
门外等候，自己则安静地站在诸
葛亮的房间外等他起床。
page_text_en:
Liu Bei came to Zhuge Liang's house for the third time.
Zhuge Liang was not out this time, but he was taking a nap.
Liu Bei asked Guan Yu and Zhang Fei to wait outside the main gate,
while he quietly stood outside Zhuge Liang's room, waiting for him to wake up.
summary_zh: 刘备第三次拜访诸葛亮，发现他正在午睡，便让关羽和张飞在门外等候，自己则安静地在房外等待诸葛亮醒来。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 关羽和张飞在外面等了好久也没有动静，跑进去一看，原来诸葛亮还在睡觉。
page_text_en: Guan Yu and Zhang Fei had waited outside for a long time with no动静, so they ran in to check. It turned out Zhuge Liang was still asleep.
summary_zh: 关羽和张飞在门外等待许久未见诸葛亮动静，便跑进屋内查看，发现诸葛亮仍在睡觉。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 张飞气坏了，大喊：“我放火把这房子烧了，看他起不起来！”关羽急忙拉住他说：“不能这样做，大哥会生气的！”张飞只好忍住怒气。
page_text_en: Zhang Fei was furious and shouted, “I’ll set fire to this house and see if he can get up!” Guan Yu quickly held him back and said, “You can’t do that, the elder brother will be angry!” Zhang Fei could only hold back his anger.
summary_zh: 关羽和张飞在门外等待诸葛亮醒来，张飞因等不及而气愤，想放火烧房，关羽劝阻，张飞最终忍住怒气。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh:
过了很久，诸葛亮终于醒了。
他伸了个懒腰，看见刘备站在外面等他，就忙把刘备请进屋里。
page_text_en:
After a long while, Zhuge Liang finally woke up.
He stretched lazily, saw Liu Bei waiting for him outside, and hurriedly invited Liu Bei into the house.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮睡醒后，看到刘备在门外等候，便请他进屋。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 刘备向诸葛亮请教如何才能让自己的势力强大起来。诸葛亮说：“你可以先攻占西川，再发展力量，最后统一国家。”
page_text_en: Liu Bei asked Zhuge Liang how to make his power stronger. Zhuge Liang said, "You can first capture Sichuan, then develop your strength, and finally unify the country."
summary_zh: 刘备向诸葛亮请教如何壮大势力，诸葛亮建议先攻占西川，再发展力量，最终统一天下。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 刘备高兴得直拍手，他请诸葛亮帮助自己。诸葛亮摇着头说：“我已经习惯了现在的生活，不想离开。请原谅我不能帮你。”
page_text_en: Liu Bei clapped his hands with joy and asked Zhuge Liang to help him. Zhuge Liang shook his head and said, "I have already become accustomed to my current life and do not wish to leave. Please forgive me for not being able to help you."
summary_zh: 刘备向诸葛亮请教如何壮大势力，诸葛亮却婉拒了邀请，表示习惯隐居生活，不愿出山相助。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh:
刘备急得哭了起来，
他跪下来恳求诸葛亮说：
“如果先生不帮我，老百姓们还要受苦啊！”
page_text_en:
Liu Bei became so anxious that he started crying.
He knelt down and pleaded with Zhuge Liang:
"If you don't help me, the common people will still suffer!"
summary_zh: 刘备因诸葛亮婉拒出山而焦急落泪，跪地恳求他帮助百姓脱离苦难。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 诸葛亮被刘备的诚意打动了，赶紧把他扶起来，答应帮他。
page_text_en: Zhuge Liang was moved by Liu Bei's sincerity, quickly helped him up, and agreed to help him.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮被刘备的诚意打动，扶起跪地的刘备并答应出山相助。

title_en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
page_text_ocr_zh: 诸葛亮当了刘备的军师以后，第一仗就打败了曹操派来的一支军队。
page_text_en: After Zhuge Liang became Liu Bei's military advisor, he defeated an army sent by Cao Cao in his first battle.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮成为刘备的军师后，首次出战便击败了曹操派来的一支军队。
